dataset: Framingham Heart Study teaching subset (4,240 participants), public mirror
task: Prevalent hypertension at baseline predicted from NON-blood-pressure risk factors (BP readings and BP medication excluded to avoid label leakage)
selection_rule: highest 5-fold CV AUROC on the training split
threshold_rule: maximum F1 on validation split (calibrated probabilities)
limitations: Cross-sectional screening estimate (is hypertension likely present?), not a prediction of future hypertension.
Blood-pressure readings are deliberately excluded; a real BP measurement is always the proper test.
Same cohort limitations as the cardiovascular model.
disclaimer: Academic prototype. Risk score is NOT a diagnosis and is not clinically validated.
